name: Clear Transcodes
description: Adds a maintenance task that deletes files from the transcode temp directory once they are older than a configurable number of hours, so abandoned transcodes stop filling up the disk.
overview: Keeps the transcode temp folder from filling up.

versions.changelog: Fixed: when Jellyfin cannot use the configured transcode path at all, the task now logs the problem and completes instead of failing with an error. Unexpected errors during the sweep are reported the same way.

Safety: symlinks and junctions are no longer followed, so the sweep can never leave the transcode directory; a transcode path that is not Jellyfin's default now requires the new "Allow cleaning a custom transcode directory" setting; a filesystem root is refused outright; and an unreadable subfolder no longer aborts the run.

Fixed: the task deleted Jellyfin's own .jellyfin-transcode marker file. Hidden files are now never touched, and a file is only deleted when its extension is on a configurable allow-list. The default maximum file age is 6 hours.
